texts.preamble: Kanav Goyal And Another vs Union Of India And Others on 17 November, 2025 Cwp-Pil-336-2025 -1 In The High Court Of Punjab & Haryana At Chandigarh 147 Cwp-Pil-336-2025 Date of Decision: 17.11.2025
texts.facts: The instant writ petition has been preferred by the petitioners seeking issuance of a writ directing respondent No.1 to 9 to form Standing Operating Procedure for strict compliance of FSSAI Act, 2006, and Regulations of FSSAI Rules, 2011 besides other reliefs. 2. The grievance of the petitioners is that Food Safety Officers are not discharging their duties effectively as provided under the guidelines /rules of the FSSAI Act and there is no set standard procedure for the compliance of norms provided under Food Safety Act for compulsory registration of manufacturers, hawkers, mobile vendors etc. nor there are any coercive steps being taken against the wrong doers as per law. Raising the aforesaid grievance, petitioners have preferred a legal notice dated 03.10.2025 (Annexure P-7) to respondents, however no action has been taken upon the same till date.
